apply_sharding_datapipe: apply dynamic sharding over a DataPipe graph with num_of_instances and instance_id for distributed training
apply_shuffle_settings_datapipe: apply shuffle settings to a DataPipe graph, adding a Shuffler if none exists and shuffle is True
apply_random_seed_datapipe: apply random seeds from a torch.Generator to all random DataPipes in a DataPipe graph
apply_shuffle_seed_datapipe: apply shuffle seeds from a random number generator to all shuffler DataPipes in a graph
get_all_graph_pipes_datapipe: retrieve all DataPipes from a DataPipeGraph for inspection or further processing
